networks.name: Default Mode Network (DMN)
networks.description: Active during inward-focused thought, self-referential processing, and rumination.

networks.name: Salience Network
networks.description: Detects biologically and behaviorally relevant stimuli; switches between CEN and DMN.

networks.name: Central Executive Network (CEN)
networks.description: Engaged during goal-directed, task-positive cognitive control and working memory operations.

symptoms.label: Broca's (Expressive) Aphasia
symptoms.description: Non-fluent, effortful speech output with preserved comprehension.
symptoms.vascularTerritory: Left Middle Cerebral Artery (MCA) - Superior Division
symptoms.dsm5: 6A01.0 (Neurodevelopmental speech impairment) / Major Neurocognitive Disorder due to Stroke

symptoms.label: Prosopagnosia (Face Blindness)
symptoms.description: Inability to recognize familiar faces despite intact elementary visual processing.
symptoms.dsm5: Visual Agnosia sub-category under Major Neurocognitive Disorder

symptoms.label: Depressive Rumination & Deficit in Task Switching
symptoms.description: Persistent hyper-connectivity in self-referential circuits paired with CEN hypo-activation.
